nodes.description: Fibrillin-1 microfibrils are the scaffold of elastic fibers and a structural element of the mitral valve, aortic wall, dermis, periosteum and dura. Abnormal elastic fibers have been shown directly in MASS skin by histology and electron microscopy. The systemic phenotype is read as a consequence of this extracellular-matrix defect in each tissue, by analogy with Marfan syndrome; the tissue-level steps have not been studied in MASS itself, and why the ciliary zonule and the aortic media are spared is not known.
